notes: The canonical pricing-change case study: June 2025 conversion of the request-based Pro plan into an API-rate credit pool triggered documented backlash, an apology, and refunds. Pro+ ($60) and Ultra ($200) sub-tier prices are reported-only; the live page renders only the $20 base.

change_events.description: Pro changed from $20/mo for 500 fast requests to $20/mo API-rate compute credit pool plus unlimited Auto (auto-routed models); Ultra ($200/mo) introduced. Effective usage fell to roughly 225 Sonnet-4 requests vs the former 500. 'Unlimited' applied only to Auto, which was widely misunderstood.
change_events.notice_period: none — announced via blog but rollout poorly communicated; clarified June 30
change_events.grandfathering: none for the request model; full refunds offered for surprise charges June 16–July 4 via pro-pricing@cursor.com after July 4 public apology ('we missed the mark')
change_events.user_reaction: Documented backlash: surprise overages (reports of $350+/week), mass complaints, public apology and refunds

sources.note: Primary: Michael Truell post, July 4 2025 — apology, clarification, refunds

change_events.description: 'Updates to Teams and Auto' — adjustments to Teams plans and Auto usage; Pro+ tier appears on the pricing page in this era (exact launch date not verified from primary source).
